features.title: Strict agent workspace sandbox isolation
acceptance: Agent A can only read/write files under its own workspace directory
Agent A attempting to access Agent B's workspace returns permission error
Path traversal attempts (../) are blocked
Absolute paths outside workspace root are rejected

features.title: FastAPI application skeleton with health endpoint
acceptance: FastAPI app starts on configured host/port
GET /health returns 200 with status info
Basic project structure with pyproject.toml

features.title: Agent CRUD API with workspace provisioning
acceptance: POST /api/agents creates agent with isolated workspace
GET /api/agents lists agents
GET /api/agents/{id} returns agent details
DELETE /api/agents/{id} removes agent and workspace

features.title: MCP tool exposure for memory system
acceptance: MCP server exposes memory read/write tools
External AI clients can connect via MCP protocol
Tools are namespaced per agent workspace

features.title: User isolation with pre-configured specialists
acceptance: Admin can create specialist agents with pre-configured models/skills/MCP
Regular users get assigned specialists without configuration access
User data/files/workspaces are isolated from each other

features.title: PostgreSQL backup/restore with pg_dump
acceptance: Backup works with SQLite (default) and PostgreSQL
pg_dump availability checked at startup for PostgreSQL mode
Restore works for both database types

features.title: PostgreSQL connection pool with liveness checks
acceptance: Connection pool uses explicit liveness check (SELECT 1)
Configurable max_lifetime to avoid cron-window recycling clashes
Dead connections are detected and replaced before use
